title: REQ · Device-pixel-ratio zoom helper is safe for invalid ratios
summary: computeZoom never returns less than 1 or NaN for bad dpr input
description: Context: computeZoom(w,h,dpr) floors min((w*dpr)/640,(h*dpr)/360). A dpr of 0, negative or NaN yields 0/NaN-driven results. Desired: invalid dpr is treated as 1. Expected: integer >= 1 always.
acceptance_criteria: Given dpr is NaN, 0 or negative, When computeZoom(1280,720,dpr) runs, Then it returns 2
Given dpr 2 and a 1000x600 viewport, When computeZoom runs, Then it returns an integer >= 1
